note: Dylan Garity's 7/31/2015 highlights in Our Numbered Days (Neil Hilborn). Sam approved fast-tracking them into Poetry Please on 2026-11-17. Primary Excerpt Database rows 46826-46845.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.poem: MSP PHI LGA ALB PHI MSP
records.excerpt:
How miraculous,
flight is just a fall that never finds the ground.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
I am a pile of bricks and you are holding a sledgehammer,
which is to say I would not exist without you.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
Snow is a sentient being
that hates when people drive in straight lines.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
Don't be alone. When you are alone,
you won't do anything you did with her,
so you won't do anything.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
The way the blade stays
out of focus until it’s called. The way
your life is sharper once it’s gone.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
When we call each other halfway
across the country, we are paying
for the illusion that distance does not exist.
We are paying to pretend
that one day, if we reach hard enough,
we will touch each other.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
For her, I sent away
the best parts of me.
I have not come back.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
But when I saw her, the only thing
I could think about was the hairpin curve
of her lips or the eyelash on her cheek

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
She told me that she shouldn't
have let me get so attached to her,
that this whole thing was a mistake,
but how can it be a mistake
that I don't have to wash my hands
after I touch her? Love is not a mistake.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
I want her back so bad,
I leave the door unlocked.
I leave the lights on.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
Nothing changes just because
you want it to.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
How to Kill Yourself without Hurting Anyone
Don’t.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
No one ever taught me how to pray,
so I won’t. Instead, I’ll just say this:
god bless the shape your head leaves
in my pillow; god bless your insatiable
hair; god bless you, though the hour is late,
for you have come to me at last.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
A broken clock is right twice a day, but there is no time
at which a broken windshield is useful.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
It would be great if it would rain on me
because then there would be a reason I felt like garbage
right now. There’s always, of course, a reason, but it would be
nice to say It’s raining only on my head rather than
I have a chemical imbalance in my brain or I just remembered
that someone I love will die before I do.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
So suck it,
depression. I don’t need you, I have
not needed you, and even when I don’t
mean it I will say I’m having fun
and I don’t want to be anywhere else.
I will wield my joy like a broadsword
or a fucking nerf gun. I will have
fun like my life depends on it
because it does.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
Whatever
you are feeling right now, there is
a mathematical certainty that someone
is feeling that exact thing. This is not
to say you aren't special. This is to say
thank god you aren't special.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
See, we are wrong when we say I think,
therefore I am. The more we say it,
the more it sounds like, “I think,
therefore I will be.” You cannot think yourself
into a full table. You cannot think and make
walls and a roof appear around you.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.poem: American Revolution Trail, Charlotte, North Carolina, Winter
records.excerpt:
Everything here is beautiful and none of it’s home.
I feel like I’ve spent my whole life in transit. Strange
when I should want to, but I don’t want to, stop.

records.author: Neil Hilborn
records.excerpt:
I will whisper your name
from the cracks in the canyon rocks
and you will know that this is heaven,
knowing that someone will always remember
your irises and where you hid your love
letters and why you could never speak
in anything but short sentences.
